methods.name: Naive — pooled Wilson
methods.note: All N x K answers treated as independent Bernoulli trials.

methods.name: Question means + t
methods.note: Per-question mean accuracy, t-interval over the N question means.

methods.name: Cluster-robust by question
methods.note: Pooled mean with a cluster-robust (sandwich) standard error by question and a t critical value.

methods.name: Two-stage bootstrap
methods.note: Resample questions, then seeds within each question; percentile interval over 2,000 draws.

methods.name: Hierarchical Bayesian
methods.note: Logistic model with a question random effect (NumPyro NUTS); coverage measured on 200 subsamples per design, not 2,000.

methods.name: Seed-only (different estimand)
methods.note: Questions treated as fixed: this interval is for accuracy on these questions only, not for new questions.
